keywords: The Appellant challenged the High Court revision order setting aside his acquittal and directing retrial on charges of grievous and simple hurt in terms of Sections 314 and 316 of the Penal Code. Held - Magistrate had erred in fact, misdirected on medical evidence and improper reliance on unproduced police statement of deceased witness. Appeal dismissed.
